propositions: rebar's LLM runtime currently branches on provider-name strings at multiple locations instead of using pydantic-ai's provider_factory hook, hardcoding Anthropic capabilities and blocking base_url/api_key configuration

AWS Bedrock is not supported as a first-class provider; PR #121's OpenAI-compatible gateway works but silently loses prompt caching, retrying transport, timeouts, and native structured output, plus records an incorrect model string in signed verdict sidecars

The provider abstraction must use pydantic-ai's extension points (provider_factory hook and per-vendor ModelProfile) to support Anthropic, Bedrock, and best-effort OpenAI-compatible providers with equivalent capabilities and provenance tracking

Bedrock retry and timeout configuration through botocore.config.Config and BedrockProvider(bedrock_client=...) is designed but not shipped; production Bedrock path runs with no retry envelope or read timeout, while direct-Anthropic path has both

Signed verdict sidecars must record structured provider provenance (provider name, model, endpoint host, support tier, effective capabilities) instead of a bare model string so consumers can distinguish first-class from best-effort verdicts

REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL and REBAR_LLM_API_KEY are documented as working but currently rejected by _pai_check_config; they must compose correctly with REBAR_LLM_MODEL_PROVIDER to route through OpenAI-compatible builders to custom endpoints
